title: Seeing Dolphins on Zanzibar, Responsibly
excerpt: Dolphin trips at Kizimkazi are popular, but not always responsible. How to see dolphins without disturbing them.
body:
Dolphins live in the waters off the south of Zanzibar, especially around Kizimkazi. Many boats go out to see them.

## The problem

At busy times, several boats chase the same group, and visitors jump in to swim near the dolphins. That disturbs their resting and feeding.

## How to do it better

- Choose an operator that limits the number of boats and keeps distance.
- Do not ask the captain to chase the dolphins.
- Watch from the boat instead of swimming with them.
- Go early, when there are fewer boats.

## Alternatives

Dolphins are also regularly seen on [Safari Blue](/blog/safari-blue-zanzibar/) trips and on the way to [Mnemba](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/).

## Why it matters

Responsible tourism helps keep dolphins in the area. See [ten ways to travel more responsibly](/blog/responsible-safari-tips/).
